_description: Source registry for Canadian utility rate scrapers. Each entry maps a utility to its data sources and scraper implementation.

utilities.name: Enbridge Gas

sources.description: Residential natural gas rates for the Enbridge Gas Distribution service area
Commercial and industrial natural gas rates

utilities.notes: Enbridge Gas Inc. was formed by the merger of Enbridge Gas Distribution and Union Gas in 2019. Rates vary by rate zone (former EGD vs. former Union Gas territories). Regulated by the Ontario Energy Board (OEB).

utilities.name: Énergir

sources.description: Residential natural gas rates in Quebec
Commercial and industrial gas rates

utilities.notes: Énergir (formerly Gaz Métro) is the principal natural gas distributor in Quebec. Regulated by the Régie de l'énergie du Québec.

utilities.name: FortisBC Energy

sources.description: Residential natural gas rates for FortisBC Energy service area
Commercial natural gas rates

utilities.notes: FortisBC Energy is the natural gas distribution arm of FortisBC, serving most of British Columbia. Regulated by the British Columbia Utilities Commission (BCUC).

utilities.name: ATCO Gas

sources.description: ATCO residential natural gas distribution rates in Alberta

utilities.notes: ATCO Gas is one of the largest natural gas distribution companies in Alberta, serving over 1.1 million customers. Distribution charges are regulated by the Alberta Utilities Commission (AUC); commodity gas is purchased at market rates.

utilities.name: EPCOR Natural Gas

sources.description: Natural gas regulated rates for Edmonton

utilities.notes: EPCOR provides natural gas distribution in Edmonton and surrounding areas. Regulated by the Alberta Utilities Commission (AUC).

utilities.name: Centra Gas Manitoba

sources.description: Natural gas rates for Centra Gas Manitoba (operated by Manitoba Hydro)

utilities.notes: Centra Gas Manitoba is a subsidiary of Manitoba Hydro responsible for natural gas distribution in Manitoba. Regulated by the Manitoba Public Utilities Board (PUB).

utilities.name: SaskEnergy

sources.description: Natural gas delivery and commodity rates for Saskatchewan

utilities.notes: SaskEnergy is the provincial Crown corporation responsible for natural gas distribution in Saskatchewan. Rates are adjusted quarterly based on commodity price changes. Regulated by the Saskatchewan Rate Review Panel.

utilities.name: Heritage Gas

sources.description: Residential natural gas rates in Nova Scotia

utilities.notes: Heritage Gas is the natural gas distribution utility in Nova Scotia, serving the Halifax-Dartmouth metro area and parts of the province along the Maritimes and Northeast Pipeline corridor. Regulated by the Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board (NSUARB).

utilities.name: Liberty Utilities NB

sources.description: Residential natural gas rates in New Brunswick

utilities.notes: Liberty Utilities acquired the former Enbridge Gas New Brunswick operations. Regulated by the New Brunswick Energy and Utilities Board (NBEUB).

utilities.name: BC Hydro

sources.description: Residential electricity rates page with tiered pricing (Step 1 and Step 2)
Commercial and industrial electricity rate schedules

utilities.notes: BC Hydro uses a two-tier residential rate structure. Rates are regulated by the British Columbia Utilities Commission (BCUC).

utilities.name: FortisBC Electric

sources.description: Residential electricity rates for FortisBC Electric service area in southern BC interior
Commercial electricity rates

utilities.notes: FortisBC Electric serves the southern interior of British Columbia. Regulated by the British Columbia Utilities Commission (BCUC).

utilities.name: Hydro-Québec

sources.description: Residential Rate D (standard domestic rate) with tiered pricing
Business rate schedules including Rate G and Rate M

utilities.notes: Hydro-Québec offers some of the lowest electricity rates in North America. Rates are regulated by the Régie de l'énergie du Québec.

utilities.name: Manitoba Hydro

sources.description: Residential electricity rates including basic charge and energy charge
Commercial and industrial electricity rates

utilities.notes: Manitoba Hydro is a Crown corporation providing electricity in Manitoba. Electricity rates are among the lowest in Canada due to abundant hydroelectric generation. Regulated by the Manitoba Public Utilities Board (PUB).

utilities.name: SaskPower

sources.description: Residential electricity rates for Saskatchewan
Commercial electricity rates

utilities.notes: SaskPower is the principal electricity supplier in Saskatchewan, a provincial Crown corporation. Regulated by the Saskatchewan Rate Review Panel.

utilities.name: NB Power

sources.description: Residential electricity rates and tariff schedules
Complete schedule of rates and tariffs document (PDF)

utilities.notes: NB Power is a vertically integrated Crown corporation and the primary electricity provider in New Brunswick. Regulated by the New Brunswick Energy and Utilities Board (NBEUB).

utilities.name: Nova Scotia Power

sources.description: Electricity rates and tariff schedules for Nova Scotia
Domestic (residential) service tariff details

utilities.notes: Nova Scotia Power is the sole electricity provider for the majority of Nova Scotia, a subsidiary of Emera Inc. Regulated by the Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board (NSUARB).

utilities.name: Maritime Electric

sources.description: General rules, regulations, and schedules of rates for Prince Edward Island

utilities.notes: Maritime Electric is the primary electricity distributor in Prince Edward Island, a subsidiary of Fortis Inc. Regulated by the Island Regulatory and Appeals Commission (IRAC).

utilities.name: Newfoundland Power

sources.description: Residential and commercial electricity rates and tariff schedule for the island of Newfoundland

utilities.notes: Newfoundland Power is a subsidiary of Fortis Inc. and the primary electricity distributor on the island of Newfoundland. Regulated by the Newfoundland and Labrador Board of Commissioners of Public Utilities (PUB).

utilities.name: NL Hydro

sources.description: Electricity rates for NL Hydro service areas (rural Newfoundland, coastal Labrador, and isolated systems)

utilities.notes: NL Hydro (Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro) is a Crown corporation that generates most of the province's electricity and distributes in rural and isolated areas. Regulated by the Newfoundland and Labrador Board of Commissioners of Public Utilities (PUB).

utilities.name: Yukon Energy

sources.description: Residential electricity rates in Yukon

utilities.notes: Yukon Energy Corporation is the Crown-owned generation and transmission utility in Yukon. Regulated by the Yukon Utilities Board (YUB).

utilities.name: Yukon Electrical Company

sources.description: ATCO Electric Yukon (formerly Yukon Electrical Company) distribution rates

utilities.notes: Yukon Electrical Company (now operating as ATCO Electric Yukon) is the distribution utility in Yukon. Regulated by the Yukon Utilities Board (YUB).

utilities.name: Northwest Territories Power Corporation

sources.description: Current residential electricity rates for NWT communities

utilities.notes: NTPC is a territorial Crown corporation generating and distributing electricity across the Northwest Territories. Rates vary significantly by community (hydro vs. diesel generation). Regulated by the Northwest Territories Public Utilities Board (PUB).

utilities.name: Qulliq Energy Corporation

sources.description: Electricity rate information for Nunavut communities

utilities.notes: Qulliq Energy Corporation is the sole electricity provider in Nunavut, operating diesel generation in each community. Rates vary by community and include territorial subsidy components. Regulated by the Utility Rates Review Council of Nunavut (URRC).
